summary: The victim was lured into a fake VIP cryptocurrency trading group through an impersonated company executive on social media and transferred funds to attacker controlled addresses. The platform displayed fabricated account balances to encourage additional deposits while the deposited funds were lost.
user_mistake: Trusted an impersonated company representative and transferred funds to a fake investment group.
prevention: Verify identities through official company channels / Reject investment groups promoted through unsolicited social media contacts
